import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sales by Product (Top left)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors1 = sns.color_palette('Blues_d', len(product_sales))
axes[0, 0].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors1)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v + 50, i, f'${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Sales by Customer Age Group (Top right)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('Greens_d', len(age_sales))
bars = axes[0, 1].bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors2, edgecolor='darkgreen', linewidth=1.2)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, age_sales.values):
    axes[0, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 100, 
                    f'${val:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Plot 3: Payment Method Distribution with Takeaway Split (Bottom left)
payment_takeaway = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
payment_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors3 = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c']
payment_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 0], color=colors3, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sales by Payment Method & Order Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper right')
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 4: Size Distribution by Product (Bottom right)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_product = df.groupby(['product', 'size']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
size_product = size_product.reindex(columns=size_order)
colors4 = ['#f39c12', '#9b59b6', '#1abc9c']
size_product.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], color=colors4, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Orders', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Order Size Distribution by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Size', loc='upper right')
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
